name: Cache Pilot
description: Simple tools to manage the APCu and OPcache caches.
project_description: Cache Pilot provides tools to clear and inspect the APCu and Zend OPcache opcode/user caches from within Drupal. Because those caches live in the PHP-FPM worker processes and cannot be reset from a CLI (Drush) process, the module talks to PHP-FPM over a FastCGI socket (TCP or Unix domain socket) and runs a small bundled script (cache-pilot.php) inside the FPM pool to perform apcu_clear_cache() / opcache_reset() and read apcu_cache_info() / opcache_get_status(). It exposes a settings form (Configuration > Development > Performance > Cache Pilot) to configure the FastCGI DSN, an admin reports dashboard rendering APCu and OPcache statistics, two Drush/console commands for deployment scripts, and a hook_cache_flush() integration that clears APCu on a Drupal cache rebuild. All routes and actions require the 'cache_pilot.administer' permission.
